en.name: Turkey deli meat, pre-packaged
en.summary: A sealed pack of pre-packaged turkey deli meat keeps 2 weeks from purchase in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened. Freezing is not recommended for quality, though an unopened pack will hold 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: Sliced turkey breast is cooked, moist, low in acid and eaten with no further cooking — the classic ready-to-eat profile associated with Listeria, and turkey breast is one of the products specifically named in that advice. Listeria grows slowly even at refrigeration temperature, which is why the opened figure is days rather than weeks. Keep the pack cold on the way home; out of the fridge it gets two hours at most, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F). A sandwich platter left out through an afternoon is the situation to avoid.
en.fridge: Unopened, 2 weeks from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below; once opened, 3–5 days. Store it on a cold shelf rather than in the door, wrapped airtight or in a sealed box so the slices do not dry and grey at the edges, and away from raw meat. People who are pregnant, elderly or immunocompromised are generally advised to avoid non-dried deli meats such as turkey breast, or to heat them until steaming hot before eating them.
en.freezer: Freezing is not recommended. Turkey breast is lean and usually brine-injected, so the slices release a lot of water on thawing and come back wet, soft and saltier, tearing as you peel them apart. If you freeze it anyway, an unopened pack holds 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze the pack flat and well inside the fridge window, and use the thawed slices in a cooked dish — a toasted sandwich, a pasta bake — rather than cold.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge and use within the opened window. Never thaw on the counter, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: A slimy or tacky film on the slices — the first reliable sign.
A sour, sulphurous or ammonia-like smell on opening.
Grey, green or iridescent patches, or dried dark edges.
A puffed pack, or cloudy ropy liquid inside it.
tips: Write the opening date on the pack; the sealed figure does not carry over.
Keep it on a cold shelf, never in the fridge door.
Reseal after taking out what you need.
Heat until steaming if you are pregnant or immunocompromised.

faq.q: How long does packaged turkey deli meat keep?
faq.a: 2 weeks from purchase unopened at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened.
It is not recommended — the slices come back wet and soft. If you do, an unopened pack holds 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C.

faq.q: Is deli turkey safe during pregnancy?
faq.a: Turkey breast is a non-dried deli meat, the category pregnant people are advised to avoid because of Listeria. Heating it until steaming hot first is the usual advice.

zh.name: 包裝火雞肉片
zh.summary: 未開封的包裝火雞肉片，自購買日起放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。基於品質不建議冷凍，但未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可放 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 火雞胸肉片是煮熟、含水、低酸性，而且不會再加熱就被吃掉——正是最常與李斯特菌連結的即食型態，而火雞胸肉更是相關衛教中被直接點名的產品之一。李斯特菌在冷藏溫度下仍會緩慢生長，這就是開封後的期限以「天」計而不是以「週」計的原因。買回家路上要保冷；離開冰箱最多兩小時，氣溫超過 32 °C 時最多一小時。三明治拼盤在外面放一整個下午，就是要避免的情況。
zh.fridge: 未開封自購買日起放 4 °C 以下 2 週；開封後 3～5 天。請放冷藏層架而不是門邊，密封包好或裝密閉盒，避免肉片邊緣乾掉發灰，並與生肉分開。懷孕、年長或免疫功能低下者，一般建議避開火雞胸這類非乾式熟肉，或先加熱到冒蒸氣再吃。
zh.freezer: 不建議冷凍。火雞胸很瘦，而且通常注過鹽水，所以解凍時會釋出大量水分，回來時濕軟、更鹹，一撕就破。真要冷凍，未開封包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。請平放冷凍、並在冷藏期限還充裕時處理；解凍後的肉片建議用在加熱料理——熱壓三明治、焗烤麵——而不是冷食。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，並在開封後的期限內用完。不要放室溫退冰，也不要二次冷凍。
spoilage: 肉片表面出現黏滑或發黏的薄膜——最早也最可靠的徵兆。
拆封時聞到酸味、硫味或氨味。
出現灰色、綠色或虹彩光澤的斑，或邊緣乾黑。
包裝鼓脹，或裡面的汁液混濁牽絲。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日期，未開封的數字不能延用。
放冷藏層架，絕對不要放門邊。
取出需要的量之後把包裝封回去。
懷孕或免疫功能低下者，請加熱到冒蒸氣再吃。

faq.q: 包裝火雞肉片可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。
不建議，解凍後會濕軟。真要冷凍，未開封包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。

faq.q: 懷孕可以吃即食火雞片嗎？
faq.a: 火雞胸屬於非乾式熟肉，正是建議孕婦因李斯特菌風險避開的那一類。若要吃，通常建議先加熱到冒蒸氣。
